name: Trigger 1
description: When Counting-section passengers/day exceeds 6,000 passenger-trips/day for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 4-year lead time.

name: Trigger 2
description: When Annual passenger congestion delay exceeds 682,000 person-hours/year for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 6-year lead time.
